name: parkease
description: ParkEase - Smart Parking Management & Booking System

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.dev: start npm run dev:backend && start npm run dev:frontend
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix backend && npm run build --prefix frontend
scripts.test: npm run test:backend && npm run test:frontend
scripts.db:migrate: cd backend && npx prisma migrate dev
scripts.db:seed: cd backend && npx prisma db seed
